data.name: Haarun
data.gender_notes: Haarun is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Haarun is derived from the Arabic word ‘hawaan’ which means ‘the sun’. This name is mentioned in the Quran in Surah Al-Anfal, verse 46, Haarun Al-Aswad was a powerful king who was guided by Prophet Musa (AS) towards the right path. The name Haarun carries the meaning “The sun” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Haarun usually hope their child will grow to embody the sun and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes enlightenment and guidance towards the righteous path.
data.etymology: Haarun belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “The sun.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Haarun total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_arabic.name: هارون
in_arabic.meaning: اسم علم مذكر من أصل عربي و يعني النور و الهداية
in_arabic.long_meaning: هارون هو اسم علم مذكر من أصل عربي، مشتق من كلمة 'هار' التي تعني النور و الهداية. و يعتبر هارون من الأسماء المحببة في الإسلام، حيث أنه اسم نبي الله هارون عليه السلام، أخو موسى عليه السلام. و يرمز الاسم إلى الشخص الذي يتميز بالهداية و النور الداخلي.

in_urdu.name: ہارون
in_urdu.meaning: نام علم مذکر، معنی نور، ہدایت، اچھائی
in_urdu.long_meaning: ہارون ایک نام علم مذکر ہے جو عربی زبان سے ماخوذ ہے۔ اس کا مطلب ہے نور، ہدایت، اور اچھائی۔ یہ نام اسلامی تاریخ میں اہم مقام رکھتا ہے کیونکہ حضرت ہارون علیہ السلام، حضرت موسی علیہ السلام کے بھائی تھے۔ یہ نام ان خصوصیات کو ظاہر کرتا ہے جو ایک فرد میں ہونی چاہئیں، جیسے کہ اچھائی، نور، اور ہدایت۔

in_english.name: Haarun
in_english.meaning: Derived from Arabic, meaning enlightenment, light, and guidance
in_english.long_meaning: Haarun is a masculine given name of Arabic origin, derived from the root 'H-R-W-N', which signifies enlightenment, light, and guidance. In Islamic tradition, Haarun (Harun) is the name of the brother of Prophet Moses (Musa). The name connotes a person who embodies guidance, wisdom, and inner light. It symbolizes virtues such as righteousness, illumination, and leadership.
